build_notes:
^xC8C8C8^7Acts 1 - 2
Mule a momentum from a ranger
Use ^xB97123^x7070FFRolling Magma^7^7
Buy Boots with movement speed whenever you see them or gamba with gold
Look for wands with ^xB97123+1 fire^7/all or ^xB97123increased fire/flat fire to spells^7
If you get an Ashcaller or an Abberath's Horn, you have your wands until the end of campaign
Level with ^xB97123Rolling Magma ^7and^7 ^xB97123^xE05030Holy Flame Totem^7
^xC8C8C8^7You can swap to^7^7 ^xADAA47Storm Burst Totems^7 at level 12, but I stuck with rolling magma until act 3
Swapping to Storm Burst Totems will need a different guide, go look at dsLily's
During Act 2, pick up ^xB97123^xE05030Herald of Ash^7^7 and ^xADAA47^xADAA47^x7070FFHerald of Thunder^7^7^7, and use them until you can fit ^xE05030Anger^7/^xE05030Determ^7 or ^x70FF70Haste^7 in Act 3

Act 3 - 10
At level 28, use a combo of ^xB97123^x7070FFFirestorm^7^7 and ^xB97123^x7070FFArma Brand^7^7, or you can just use ^xB97123Firestorm^7 on ^x7070FFArca Brand^7 with Flame Totems
Only use 1 wand still so you can keep shield charging <--- Ignore this note if you're twink leveling and you have a 7-league step
If you don't have an Ashcaller or Abberath's Horn, you can also use minion wands now for damage since we have the minion nodes
Make sure you're leveling the gems you need to transition after the campaign

KF Transition
Transition is pretty simple, I have the baseline here, but there's nothing I can add here that Palsteron didn't already mention
You can spend as long as you need following Pals version until you're ready to strength stack
Here's his link https://pobb.in/1C-c2Ym44cZQ
The items I have on here are pretty basic for you to get started

Str Stack Transition
Replica Alberons is required, this should be your first purchase to transition into str stack
The wand is super cheap and can carry you for a bit
Astramentis is a good one to have as well
Cluster jewel is cheap to get started w/o Increased Effect, and upgrade from 8 until you can afford 12 WITH the Increased effect
Split personalities go into the cluster jewel to solve int and str requirements
Make sure the rest of your gear has strength on everything if possible; Cap out block and Resists ASAP
Buy a cheap lethal pride to get some strength going, When you have more moneyu look for 2x Double damage and the rest % str
Astramentis Annoints can be Disintegration, Hasty Demise, or Shamans Dominion depending budget -- HASTY is preferred
When you have money, focus on getting mageblood and simplex ASAP. Spicysushi has a video on how to craft the amulet
Link to Sushi's crafting video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gx8rmW-miyU

^xE05030Str Stack Aspirational^7
Item upgrades go a long way when you put budget into str stack
First is getting a double annointed helmet
The second are 3p/1p voices for more str jewels
Third is getting mirrored Str/All attributes Helical
Can also get % str corrupted mageblood and volatile vaal corrupted boots
+2 proj +2duration +1 all gems are good corrupts for the iron fortress
%attributes elder everything bound by destiny is turbo aspirational and difficult to get to as well

Progenesis and Returning proj imbued KF when mapping
Life flask and Conc effect when uber bossing (no need to swap to this for standard bosses)
Figure out whatever
